title: Existence of the canonically normalized global projection package
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X to Y and ring sheaves RY,RX with a specified isomorphism f-inverse RY to RX, the Global projection datum of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data] is inhabited. This asserts the global operations, representative-normalized tensor models and shifts only; it asserts neither a localization square nor cover-local detection.

source.place: Tags 08FI (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), 0FN5 (lemma-localize-cartesian-square-modules), 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product); slice-topos restriction of the counit map 0B56.

proof.text: Use the specified coefficient adjunct for sectionwise module direct image. Its canonical left adjoint is isomorphic through adjoint uniqueness to the explicit pro-etale inverse-image module functor. Transfer additivity and exactness across this isomorphism. Construct the exact derived pullback and K-injective derived pushforward.

The derived adjunction counit computes the module counit on K-injective representatives by its defining factorization. Compatibility of the right-derived unit with shifts descends through the K-injective equivalence; the exact-derived unit formula and the adjunction shift criterion give the counit shift equation.

Localize the signed total tensor on flat-term K-flat pairs. Its full-faithfulness statement gives the required tensor-model descent; its representative comparison is the recorded cochain comparison. Descend the first and signed second integer shifts, and cancel the shifted representative isomorphisms to obtain the two tensor normalization equations.

Transport the ordinary pro-etale tensor pullback isomorphism through adjoint uniqueness. Its pure-unit equation follows from correspondence of the units and functoriality of sheafified pure tensors. Apply the separate canonical tensor comparison result to these already constructed operations, models and shifts, then fill the Global structure.
